name: SPT Realism Value Range Generator
teaser: SPT Realism Value Range Generator is a bilingual GUI/CLI tool for editing realism rules, generating patch output, auditing results, and reproducing SPT Realism tuning workflows at scale.
description:
SPT Realism Value Range Generator v1.2

The author is Chinese and has never handled a gun. The generator’s numerical ranges are primarily based on personal in-game feel, wiki entries, and AI suggestions. Therefore, any suggestions regarding the numerical values ​​are welcome in the comments section.

SPT Realism Value Range Generator is a toolset designed specifically for SPT Realism Mod 1.6.4.

When the Realism mod is updated to SPT4, this program will be updated accordingly.

compatible mods / 兼容的MOD all for 3.11.4

  • WTT - Pack ‘n’ Strap
  • Tactical Gear Component
  • SPT Battlepass
  • WTT- Armory 1.2.1
  • Sig Sauer MCX VIRTUS multi carlibre rifle
  • Eukyre’s AK-50 backport
  • 50 BMG Expansion and Remaster
  • Resonant AK from COD:MW2019 - ReUpload
  • Mag Tape
  • BlackCore
  • Epic’s All in One 3.1.4
  • Eco’s Attachment Emporium 1.2.1
  • ECOT - Eukyre’s Consortium of Things 1.1.0
  • WTT- Artem 2.1.2
  • Echoes of Tarkov - Requisitions (outdate)
  • Raid Overhaul (outdate)

English

Overview

This project consolidates the GUI editor, CLI generator, rule files, item exception management, and output auditing into one .NET solution.

Main Features

  • Generate Realism patches quickly.
  • Use a logical rule system and value ranges to standardize generated patch values.
  • Allow users to adjust the value ranges themselves.
  • Generate patch values through a pseudorandom seed-based system.
  • Use rules/item_exceptions.json to customize exceptions for specific item properties, allowing flexible stat design without breaking overall balance.
  • Provide an audit feature to automatically check whether generated patches violate the rules.
  • Support reading and generating six different item mod data structure styles used around version 3.11.4.

Quick Start

  1. Put your source JSON files under input.
  2. Launch the GUI or run the CLI generator.
  3. Review generated files under output.
  4. Run the audit if you want a rule-violation report.

Common audit parameters:

  • –output-dir
  • –report-file
  • –include-ok
  • –include-template-exports
  • –fail-on-violations

Directory Layout

The program uses the repository root as its default data root.

  • input
  • 现实主义物品模板
  • output
  • audit_reports
  • rules

Current Behavior Notes

  • output is not cleared as a whole directory before each run; only current target files are overwritten.
  • each generation samples fresh values within the configured ranges, so repeated runs can produce different numeric results for the same item.
  • output preserves input source order so generated files follow the source file item order for easier manual review.
  • consumable and ordinary cosmetic items are outside the generation scope.
  • Item exceptions are exempted per field during audit instead of skipping whole items.

Item Exceptions

The Item Exceptions window supports searching generated items by Name, loading their current top-level fields, editing allowed fields, and saving per-item overrides into rules/item_exceptions.json.

中文

作者是个中国人，没摸过枪，生成器的数值范围主要依靠游戏内个人手感/wiki百科/AI的建议。所以如果有任何对于数值的建议，欢迎在评论区留言。

SPT 现实主义数值范围编辑生成器 是专门为SPT Realism Mod 1.6.4设计的工具集。

当现实主义MOD更新到SPT4后，本程序将同步更新。

简介

本项目将 GUI 编辑器、CLI 生成器、规则文件、例外物品管理和输出检修统一收拢到同一个 .NET 解决方案中。

主要功能

  • 可快捷地生成现实主义补丁
  • 使用一套符合逻辑的规则体系和数值范围来规范生成的补丁数值
  • 数值范围可由用户自行调整
  • 补丁的数值由随机种子系统进行伪随机生成
  • 通过 rules/item_exceptions.json，可对个别物品的属性进行例外定制。在不破坏数值平衡的情况下，可随意设计属性。
  • 检修功能，可自动化检查生成的补丁是否违反规则。
  • 支持读取和生成3.11.4版本时期六种不同编写习惯的物品MOD数据结构。

快速开始

  1. 将待处理 JSON 放入 input。
  2. 启动 GUI，或直接运行 CLI 生成器。
  3. 在 output 中检查生成结果。
  4. 如果需要规则检查报告，再运行检修。

常用检修参数:

  • –output-dir
  • –report-file
  • –include-ok
  • –include-template-exports
  • –fail-on-violations

目录约定

程序默认以仓库根目录为数据根。

  • input
  • 现实主义物品模板
  • output
  • audit_reports
  • rules

当前行为说明

  • output 不会在每次运行前整目录清空，只覆盖当前目标文件。
  • 每次生成都会在配置范围内重新采样，因此同一物品在重复生成时可能出现不同数值结果。
  • output 会保留输入源顺序，生成结果按源文件中的条目顺序写出，便于人工核对。
  • consumable 和普通 cosmetic 不在物品生成范围内。
  • item_exceptions 在检修时按字段豁免，而不是整件物品跳过。

例外物品

例外物品窗口支持按 Name 搜索已生成物品、读取当前顶层字段、编辑允许字段，并将每个物品的覆盖规则保存到 rules/item_exceptions.json。

dependencies.name: SPT Realism Mod
dependencies.teaser: Realistic Overhaul of SPT designed around making the game experience as realistic and hardcore as possible. Highly configurable!

versions.description:
SPT Realism Mod v1.6.4 for SPT 3.11

Note: please see the “known issues” section at the bottom of this post before reporting issues.

Changes:

  • Added config option for stance SFX volume

Fixes:

  • Fixed loud sound effect when transitioning stances

Known Issues:

  • Balancing is always on-going.
  • Continuous healing is not compatible with the medical system, recommended to disable it.
  • Using limb selector to heal (hotkey + scroll) can cause strange animation issues and potentially bugs.
  • Glock 18C recoil is bugged, BSG issue.
  • High ready sprint animation bugs out sometimes, BSG issue (haven’t seen it happen in 3.11 yet).
  • Can hit self with melee in the legs.
  • SPT/EFT is cursed.

versions.description:
v1.22

Adjustments

  • Removed CLI command line, only GUI remains.

  • Optimized GUI layout.

Fixes

  • Fixed the issue of overlapping search tooltip text and buttons in the Exception Items window in the English interface.

  • Fixed the issue where the column size of the Exception Items window was too wide when first opened, requiring manual dragging to restore the proper proportions.

  • Fixed the issue where SplitContainer crashed during the initialization phase of the Exception Items window in the release version due to a conflict between the minimum panel width and the default column spacing.

Verification

  • Added integration tests to confirm that the same seed will generate completely identical output.

versions.description:
v1.2 Release Notes / v1.2 更新说明

Highlights / 主要更新

  • Generation now uses a fresh runtime seed by default, so repeated runs can resample values within the configured ranges
  • 生成器现在默认使用新的运行时随机种子，因此重复生成时会在配置范围内重新采样
  • CLI generation now supports a –seed parameter so the same run can be reproduced when needed
  • CLI 生成命令现已支持 –seed 参数，便于在需要时复现同一轮生成结果
  • GUI generation now supports an optional seed input, including quick clear and reuse of the most recently used generation seed
  • GUI 现在也支持可选种子输入，并提供快速清空以及回填最近一次实际使用的种子的能力
